name: Beemim
description: A star 91 parsecs away, 42 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.

radius.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 20535: radius 41.658 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 419.888 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.07) and temperature

temperature.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 20535: effective temperature 4051 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.088)

gravity.source: SIMBAD's compilation of spectroscopic measurements (mesFe_h): log g 1.71 from 1990ApJS...74.1075M, the median of its 3 spectra; the 3 published values span log g 1.71 to 1.71, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.0% of the centre brightness

distance.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 20535: distance 90.826 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.034), at which the luminosity and radius hold

text.card: A star 91 parsecs away, 42 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.
text.introduction: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 420 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,051 K, so 41.658 solar radii.
text.locator: Table 2, HIP 20535: D, Teff, L, Rad, Q

quotes.title: Upsilon3 Eridani
quotes.card: Upsilon3 Eridani, officially named Beemim, is a star in the constellation of Eridanus.
quotes.introduction: It is visible to the naked eye with an apparent visual magnitude of 3.96 The distance to this star, based upon an annual parallax shift of 11.01 mas, is around 296 light-years.

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 4871775051598300160 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none
